IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy black hair
stands against a warm off-white backdrop. She
wears a black ribbed knit long-sleeve top with a
sheer lace yoke and a lace neck tie, layered over a
low-rise black belt with a silver western buckle.
Below, a dark green and navy plaid pleated mini
skirt with sheer black tulle trim. Her expression is
calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of
black, forest green, and soft ivory. Dark and
romantic, in the style of a grunge-inspired knitwear
lookbook.
